scope: Matched Qwen3.5-2B CPU+NPU INT8: 128 input/64 output/context512, three full warmups and three measured runs each. Both use pooled recurrent CPU scan; candidate adds pooled prefill sigmoid through opt-in fused_ffn. Exact twelve prior INT8 sequences; no output-quality, whole-model W8A8, API, or model-max qualification.

measured_range_and_outliers.rule: candidate outlier if >3x or <1/3 of three-sample median; descriptive only; all measured rows retained
candidate outlier if >3x or <1/3 of three-sample median; descriptive only; all measured rows retained

gains_candidate_over_control.decode_interpretation: Measured ranges overlap; no decode improvement established.

metadata_corrections: Original job scope retained stale single-variant profiling text; manifest, actual argv and six trials per report establish the two-variant unprofiled comparison.
Original manifest/case role is control for both entries; variant, slug, requested_variant, actual fused_ffn argv and placement distinguish control/candidate. Original evidence preserved.

provenance.original_verifier_note: Exec handle unavailable following compaction; additional fresh closure run completed with actual terminal exit0.

control.scope: Three warmups/three measured raw-token CPU+NPU candidates, matching prior INT8 IDs and actual pooled sigmoid/GDN calls. No FP16/RKLLM quality or API qualification.

candidate.scope: Three warmups/three measured raw-token CPU+NPU candidates, matching prior INT8 IDs and actual pooled sigmoid/GDN calls. No FP16/RKLLM quality or API qualification.

device_cpu.detail: device must be CPU for CPU+NPU INT8

context.detail: context must match expected_entry and equal 512

input_ids.detail: input_ids must contain the expected exact 128 nonnegative integer token IDs

checkpoint.detail: checkpoint path must be present and match expected_entry when supplied

checkpoint_sha256.detail: checkpoint SHA256 must be present and match expected_entry when supplied

precision.detail: precision must begin with the runner's exact CPU INT8 per-channel/per-token semantics

placement_modes.detail: both prefill and decode must be on

warmup_run_counts.detail: report and expected_entry must specify exactly 3 warmups and 3 measured runs

trial_count_and_order.detail: trials must be six rows ordered as warmup=True x3 then warmup=False x3

generated_ids.detail: all six rows must contain exactly 64 nonnegative integer token IDs

measured_greedy_stability.detail: the three measured INT8 sequences must match each other; no FP16 ID comparison is made

expected_generated_ids.detail: when supplied, each of the three measured INT8 sequences must equal the expected prior INT8 control sequence

prompt_tokens.detail: every warmup and measured row must use 128 prompt tokens

timings.detail: every trial must have finite positive first_token_ms, prefill_tps and decode_tps

npu_submissions.detail: every trial must have positive prefill_submits and decode_submits

rss.detail: every trial must record positive integer peak_rss_bytes

placement.detail: placement.precision=int8 and layers/prefill_layers/decode_layers must each be positive

shared_projection_weights.detail: report and placement must confirm shared projection weights, positive shared_projection_layers, and positive packed_weight_bytes

cpu_prefill_pool.detail: when expected_entry.cpu_prefill_pool is supplied, placement.cpu_prefill_pool must match it

source_hashes.detail: source_sha256 must be a nonempty path-to-SHA256 mapping

native_replay.detail: when expected_entry requests native_replay, every captured phase must report runs>0

declared_medians.detail: runner declared first-token and decode medians must equal medians recomputed from the three measured trials

control.coverage_note: INT8 placed linear projections do not establish full-model W8A8 coverage; architecture audit is separate.
